At the Air Pollution Control Commission Public Hearing on July 15, 2026, several applications were discussed. The meeting included the acceptance of the Meeting Minutes from June 17, 2026.

question: How do I apply for a business certificate through the city?

tool_calls.name: rag
tool_calls.output: I couldn't find any public notices regarding an application for a business certificate in the City of Boston.

tool_calls.name: web_search
tool_calls.output:
Here’s how to apply for a Boston business (DBA) certificate and where to get the form and instructions.

Quick steps
1. Download and print the City Clerk business certificate form (use “New Filing” for a new DBA). ([boston.gov](https://www.boston.gov/sites/default/files/file/2025/03/March-2025-business-certificate-form.pdf?utm_source=openai))  
2. Complete the form with: business name and street address (PO boxes/virtual addresses not allowed), names and addresses of owners/interest-holders, and lease or a notarized landlord letter if there’s no lease. Signatures must be notarized. ([boston.gov](https://www.boston.gov/departments/city-clerk/how-apply-business-certificate?utm_source=openai))  
3. Pay the filing fee: $65 (plus an additional $35 if you are not a Massachusetts resident). Accepted in person: cash, credit, pinless debit, check or money order (credit/debit incurs a processor fee). You can also mail the form with a check/money order. ([boston.gov](https://www.boston.gov/departments/city-clerk/how-apply-business-certificate?utm_source=openai))  
4. Submit in person or by mail to the City Clerk’s Office (City Hall, Room 601). In-person hours are Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–4 p.m. If mailed, include a self-addressed stamped envelope for return. ([boston.gov](https://www.boston.gov/departments/city-clerk/how-apply-business-certificate?utm_source=openai))  
5. Your certificate must be renewed every four years; get a new certificate if you change your business name or address. ([boston.gov](https://www.boston.gov/departments/city-clerk/how-apply-business-certificate?utm_source=openai))

Useful Boston.gov pages (links)
- How to apply — City Clerk: “How to Apply for a Business Certificate” (instructions, fees, where to file). ([boston.gov](https://www.boston.gov/departments/city-clerk/how-apply-business-certificate?utm_source=openai))  
- Business certificate form (PDF): current City of Boston Business Certificate form. ([boston.gov](https://www.boston.gov/sites/default/files/file/2025/03/March-2025-business-certificate-form.pdf?utm_source=openai))  
- Related resources: starting a business / permits & certification pages for other requirements (permits, licensing, supplier certification). ([boston.gov](https://www.boston.gov/city-boston-services-applications-and-permits?utm_source=openai))

Need help?
If you want, I can:
- open the PDF and list the exact fields to complete, or  
- check your draft answers against the form before you print and notarize, or  
- find the City Clerk phone number so you can call with questions. Which would you like?

answer:
To apply for a business certificate (DBA) in the City of Boston, first download the business certificate form for "New Filing" [here](https://www.boston.gov/sites/default/files/file/2025/03/March-2025-business-certificate-form.pdf?utm_source=openai). Complete the form by providing the business name, street address (not a PO box), and the owners' names and addresses.
